name: DERO Blockchain Documentation
description: Read-only agent surface for the DERO privacy blockchain — daemon RPC, wallet RPC, DVM-BASIC smart contracts, privacy primitives (homomorphic encryption, ring signatures, bulletproofs), and integrity audits. Backed by a Markdown-mirrored docs corpus and the DERO MCP server.

skills.name: Query the DERO chain
skills.description: Read tip metadata, blocks, transactions, mempool, encrypted balances, and smart contract state from the DERO Stargate daemon over JSON-RPC.
examples: What is the current DERO chain height?
Read the state of SCID 0000…0001 (DERO Name Service).

skills.name: Inspect DVM-BASIC smart contracts
skills.description: Fetch contract code, classify the contract pattern, surface function signatures and stored variables, and route to the relevant DVM docs.
examples: Explain the DERO Name Service contract.
What functions does this SCID expose?
How do I deploy a TELA-DOC-1 contract?

skills.name: Audit on-chain claims end-to-end
skills.description: Verify chain-related assertions (supply integrity, transaction confirmation, contract behavior) against authoritative daemon state and curated docs citations.
examples: Verify the DERO supply integrity claim at the current tip.

skills.name: Search and navigate DERO documentation
skills.description: Full-text search across the curated DERO docs corpus (derod, tela, hologram, deropay) and recommend doc paths from natural-language intent. Every doc page has a `.md` mirror for direct agent ingestion.
examples: What should I read to understand DVM gas costs?

none.description: Public read-only documentation; site content requires no authentication. Daemon RPC and hosted MCP HTTP transport apply their own authentication where configured.

privacy_posture.rationale: DERO is a privacy-first chain; its docs surface honors the same posture.
